Single Quadrupole Mass Spectrometer 
The Agilent 5977C GC/MSD is a reliable single quadrupole mass spectrometer for routine analysis of environmental and food impurities, chemical and petrochemical analysis, as well as forensic and pharmaceutical compound analysis. 
﻿
﻿System intelligence, such as remote monitoring and instrument status alerts via email, make system monitoring easier and more effective. 
﻿New features in the 5977C GC/MSD improve productivity and analytical performance, enabling better results and green, safe resource management with the option to use hydrogen as a carrier gas. 
﻿
﻿The new HydroInert source for hydrogen applications not only minimizes disruptions due to helium starvation, but also improves spectral fidelity, peak shape, and sensitivity when using hydrogen.
Features: 
Detection limits as low as 1 fg IDL assert reliability and sensitivity for your analyses 
The new HydroInert source improves chromatographic efficiency for hydrogen carrier gas applications and minimizes loss in sensitivity and spectral anomalies associated with H2 gas 
JetClean self-cleaning ion source greatly reduces or even eliminates the need for manual source cleaning 
Built-in intelligence of the 8890, 8850, 8860, and Intuvo 9000 GCs enhances productivity with smart diagnostics, monitoring, and simplified access to powerful operations through the integrated touch screen and browser interface 
Inert Flow Path products like columns, liners, inlets, gold seals, and ferrules improve mass spectrometry workflows and ensure inertness with every surface that touches your sample 
Agilent 
CrossLab Smart Alerts software uses email-based alerts to notify you when to consider replacing key consumables and when an instrument stops running anywhere in your lab; plan your preventive maintenance and monitor instrument health remotely 
MassHunter Unknowns Analysis allows you to develop new methods with fast and reliable compound identification using its ability to create custom retention time locked spectral libraries 
MassHunter Review by Exception and Compounds at a Glance simplify and speed up data analysis and review 
Cerno Bioscience MassWorks MS calibration technology enables high mass accuracy on the 5977C GC/MSD 
To enable a better-informed, sustainable choice, Agilent has partnered with My Green Lab to have the 5977C GC/MSD independently audited for their Accountability, Consistency, and Transparency (ACT) label.
